headlines.title: Airbnb Is Building Its Own AI Travel Agent, Co-Founder Says
headlines.summary: Airbnb Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer Nathan Blecharczyk says the company is developing its own specialized AI travel agent that will eventually be able to book both on and off Airbnb's platform. In an interview with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse", he spoke about how AI is transforming Airbnb, the company's return to growth, regulation and housing in Europe, and the shift in travel beyond major cities.

headlines.title: Redburn Says Its Cautious Airbnb (ABNB) Stance Was “Wrong Over The Past Year.” Here’s What Changed
headlines.summary: We just published a list of the 10 Stocks Analysts Just Upgraded and Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) ranked 9th on this list. Wall Street spent last Thursday reminding investors how quickly a favorite theme can turn. Worries that Democratic midterm wins could bring tighter rules for artificial intelligence and data centers sent technology stocks sharply lower.

headlines.title: Airbnb reduces customer support cost per booking 17%
headlines.summary: CEO Brian Chesky said the year-over-year cost savings were driven by improvements to its AI assistant.

headlines.title: Expedia, Booking and Airbnb fall as OpenAI reportedly buys AI travel platform
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Online travel stocks fell to session lows Tuesday after The Information reported that OpenAI had acquired Odessia, an AI-powered travel planning platform, raising concerns about the potential for increased competition from artificial intelligence in the travel industry.

headlines.title: AI companies want agents to handle your everyday errands—but Uber, DoorDash, and Airbnb say barely anyone is using them for that
headlines.summary: Uber reported just four rides booked by outside agents in one week, while DoorDash and Airbnb also saw negligible activity.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
